description: Change a room app's shared state with JSON Patch ops (op: add | remove | replace | test; path: a JSON Pointer like /tasks/T3/status), applied all or nothing. Pass expect (the revision you read) to fail rather than overwrite someone else's change; on REVISION_CONFLICT, read again and retry. Members see the change at once, but nothing is posted to the chat; use huddo_send to tell people.

as.description: Identity slug to act as (default: the active identity)

expect.description: Revision the change is based on (from huddo_app_state)

room.description: roomId or index from huddo_list, for this call only (default: the default room)

name: huddo_app_submit
